# labels containing the parser's own delimiters
arrowLabel: uses -> as text
colonLabel: ratio 16:9 aspect
braceLabel: config { key }
pipeLabel: a | b | c
semiLabel: one; two; three
quoteLabel: it's "quoted" text
unicodeArrow: flows → onward
arrowLabel -> colonLabel
braceLabel -> pipeLabel: sep -> here
semiLabel -> quoteLabel
unicodeArrow -> arrowLabel
intent: Labels embedding ->, :, {, }, |, ; and a unicode arrow; probes delimiter collision in parseLine dispatch
